oil.when: 2014–2016 (first generation, service message in the instrument cluster)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed (or the scheduled service was done).
Switch the ignition to position I without starting the engine. On keyless cars, press START briefly without touching the brake.
Press and hold the OK button on the end of the left steering-column stalk.
Keep holding it and switch the ignition to position II. On keyless cars, hold START for about 2 to 3 seconds, still without the brake.
Keep holding OK for about 10 seconds until the information light starts to flash, then let go. A chime confirms the reset.
Switch the ignition off and leave it off for at least 3 minutes so the car's modules shut down normally.
oil.note: If the message does not clear, repeat the steps while holding the RESET button on the same stalk together with OK; repair technicians report that OK alone does not always work.

tpms.when: 2019 (Car Status > TPMS in the center display)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire placard on the driver's door pillar, with the car switched off. These cars have no monitored spare.
Start the car and leave it parked with the engine running. The button you need only works while the car is standing still.
On the center display, open the Car Status app from App view and tap TPMS.
Tap Calibrate (on cars built from about late 2018 the button may read Store pressure), then tap OK to confirm you checked all four tires.
Drive normally above about 22 mph (35 km/h). The system learns the new pressures while you drive; the tire symbols on the screen turn from gray to green when it has enough data.
Let it finish in the same drive. If you switch off before it completes, do the steps again.
tpms.note: This is an indirect system: until new pressures are stored it cannot warn correctly, so repeat this after every tire change or pressure adjustment. If the screen says storing was unsuccessful, try again. If the tire pressure symbol flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that this procedure will not clear; have it checked by a qualified shop.

notes: From the 2018 redesign the service message tells you to contact a workshop; the manual pages we checked give no driver reset for it.
